subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and own this Claude/GLM app-server stack as bundled plugins, or require it to remain an externally maintained plugin using generic SDK seams?
rationale: The answer determines dependency ownership, credential and sandbox accountability, package namespace, persisted-state design, core API scope, and who must provide release and upgrade proof; those are repository policy choices rather than mechanical review fixes.

options.title: External plugin plus focused SDK seams
options.body: Keep the harness packages outside core and accept only narrowly reusable SDK additions, SQLite state support, and generic auth contracts needed by external harness plugins.

options.title: Sponsor as bundled plugins
options.body: OpenClaw assumes package and security ownership, republishes or controls the bridge dependency, and requires SQLite migration plus full cross-platform fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Keep the implementation unmerged until the canonical issue establishes demand, ownership, and a maintainable scope that does not combine Claude and GLM expansion.

recommendation.title: External plugin plus focused SDK seams
recommendation.body: Keep the harness packages outside core and accept only narrowly reusable SDK additions, SQLite state support, and generic auth contracts needed by external harness plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide product, ownership, and security-boundary decision, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies this handle as the repository's product authority.
